bio.text: Joaquin Castro was born in San Antonio on September 16, 1974, and was elected in 2012 to represent Texas's 20th Congressional District, which covers a large portion of San Antonio and Bexar County.
He graduated from Stanford University in 1996 and received his law degree from Harvard Law School in 2000.
He served five terms as a state representative for Texas House District 125 before Congress.
